learning_outcomes.text: The industrial internship aims to provide students with a first insight into the practical foundations of engineering and business practice, as well as into the social conditions of employees in an industrial company.
The specialized internship includes acquiring experience and performing activities related to mechanical engineering.

syllabus_topics: Industrial-technical internship: Integration of the intern into a work environment of skilled workers, masters, and technicians with predominantly executing activity character. Typical sub-areas can be: production and processing of materials or semi-finished and finished products, assembly, commissioning, maintenance, repair, testing and quality control, plant operation.

Engineering-related internship: Integration of the intern into the work environment of engineers or correspondingly qualified persons with predominantly developing, planning, or managing activity character. Typical sub-areas can be: research, development, design, calculation, testing.
assessment_rules: The industrial internship is an ungraded study achievement worth 12 ECTS. The assessment is based on a written report.
